theorems.name: Submission.cbr_ci_cp_fp_exists_offset_eq_zero
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (ν : Measure (Euclid P)) (V : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (N : ℕ) (w : Fin N → Euclid P) (α : Fin N → ℝ), (∀ i, w i ∈ Vᗮ) → ν = ∑ i, ENNReal.ofReal (α i) • (μHE[n]).restrict {y : Euclid P | y - w i ∈ V} → (∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → 0 < ν (ball 0 r)) → ∃ i, w i = 0
